full_judgment: Chowdhury A.T.M. Masud, J. This appeal by special leave is directed against the judgment and order dated 10-2-83 passed by the High Court Division, Rangpur Bench, in Civil Revision No. 1050 of 1982 affirming the judgment and decree dated 2-6-82 passed by the Sub-ordinate Judge and Small Cause Court Judge, Dinajpur in S.S.C. Suit No. 11 of 1980. The respondent as plaintiff instituted S.C.C. Suit No. 11 of 1980, for recovery of khas possession of the suit premises by evicting the defendant appellant therefrom.
